new_scholarship.name: Bowdoin Scholarship
new_scholarship.duration: Reviewed annually; must remain a full-time student and apply for aid by the published deadline
new_scholarship.deadline: Published annually by the Office of Student Aid
new_scholarship.application_period: Aid applications are published annually. For applicants in the Class of 2031 and later, international applicants other than Canadians submit aid materials only after an admit decision.
new_scholarship.application_method: Separate financial aid application; international applicants indicate intent to apply on the admission application
new_scholarship.description: The Bowdoin Scholarship is Bowdoin College's institutional need-based grant. Bowdoin is need-blind for all students including international students and meets the full calculated need of every admitted student. Scholarships are grants that do not have to be repaid, and the aid package carries no loans. Qualifying for no-loan student aid is available to everyone, including students who reside outside the United States.
new_scholarship.best_fit: An international applicant admitted to Bowdoin who demonstrates financial need and submits the required aid materials promptly after admission.
new_scholarship.eligibility_summary: All admitted students, including international students, are eligible. Need is calculated as Cost of Attendance minus Family Contribution, and Bowdoin meets the full calculated need with Bowdoin Scholarship assistance plus a campus job expectation.
eligibility: International applicants other than Canadians must intend to apply for financial aid, indicated on the admission application
International transfer students are NOT eligible to receive aid through Bowdoin financial aid packages
Must remain a full-time student and apply for aid by the annually published deadline to stay considered
coverage: Meets 100% of the calculated financial need
No student loans in the aid package

benefits: Bowdoin Scholarship grants, which do not have to be repaid

requirements: Indicate intent to apply for financial aid on the admission application

new_scholarship.selection_notes: Bowdoin states that if you cannot submit the CSS Profile, or if the fee would be a burden, you may contact the Office of Student Aid after admission. The pages read also state the ISFAA is no longer accepted in place of the CSS Profile, which conflicts with an older international aid page that still describes the ISFAA option.
new_scholarship.notes: The award is an institutional need-based grant, not an international-specific scholarship. It applies to international students because Bowdoin is need-blind for every admitted student.
